text:
I’m a hard-working freelancer with 5 years of experience in data analysis, bookkeeping support, and spreadsheet-based reporting. I’d be glad to help bring structure to your QuickBooks, Receipt-Bank, and budget workflows.

In a past project, I built a Power Query workbook for inventory reconciliation that matched warehouse counts to the ERP every week and flagged variances. It found $86k of stock variance and reduced weekly reconciliation from 6 hours to 20 minutes.

For your business, I can help cross-check sales and expenses against DEXT Receipt-Bank and bank statements, clean and organize the transaction data, build a detailed business budget, create a family budget, and set up an inventory management sheet to track stock cost, selling price, and profit. I can also help improve document organization for clearer review.

Would you like the budget structure set up first, or should I begin with the QuickBooks and receipt reconciliation process?
